title: Two Famous Landmarks
text:
The Eiffel Tower is in Paris. It is very tall, about 330 metres. Many people visit it every year. You can take the lift to the top.

The Great Wall is in China. It is very long. It is very old. Many people walk on it.

questions.text: Why do many people visit the Eiffel Tower?
options: Because it is a famous and interesting place
Because it is a small house
Because it is closed every day
Because it is under the sea

questions.text: What can we guess about the Great Wall?
options: It is a very old place

vocabulary.definition: having a large height from bottom to top
to go to a place to see it or spend time there
having a large distance from one end to the other

paragraph_translations: Wieża Eiffla jest w Paryżu. Jest bardzo wysoka, około 330 metrów. Wiele osób odwiedza ją każdego roku. Na samą górę można wjechać windą.
Wielki Mur jest w Chinach. Jest bardzo długi. Jest też bardzo stary. Wielu ludzi chodzi po nim.
